notes.anime_tension: suspense/the_mountain-cinematic-mood: tense cinematic pad fits an anime confrontation beat.
notes.emotional_piano: sad/soulprodmusic-...-calm-piano-improvisation: solo piano is the direct instrumental match.
notes.battle_synth: epic/alex-morgan-rock-rock-music: the only driving, distorted, high-energy track in the set.
notes.quirky_ukulele: chill/alex-morgan-...-cafe-jazz: light acoustic-leaning jazz is the closest thing to a quirky, unhurried ukulele vibe on hand.
notes.sitcom_bounce: upbeat/alex-morgan-hanuman-devotional-song: the most rhythmic, energetic track in the upbeat folder; an approximation, no true sitcom-bounce cue exists yet.
notes.cartoon_chase: epic/jonasblakewood-adventure-trailer: propulsive trailer energy reads as chase music.
notes.dark_ambient: sad/vifotofreesounds-1800s-ambient-mood: moody, sparse ambience despite living in the 'sad' folder.
notes.pulse_thriller: suspense/the_mountain-epic-mood: a driving, pulsing cinematic cue.
notes.noir_jazz: chill/alex-morgan-...-cafe-jazz: literally a cafe jazz track -- the direct fit for noir jazz.
notes.quirky_marimba: chill/alex-morgan-background-music: neutral, light instrumental background stands in for a plucky marimba cue.
notes.toy_orchestra: upbeat/alex-morgan-nature-ambient: light, airy instrumentation closest to a playful toy-orchestra feel.
notes.suspense_pizzicato: suspense/virtualvisualviews-dueling-music-box-horror: a literal music box (plucked, pizzicato-like) with a horror edge.
notes.warm_family: chill/alex-morgan-background-music, upbeat/alex-morgan-gentle-baby-sleep-lullaby-dream and upbeat/tolsetmusic-...-romantic-piano: three warm, gentle, family-safe instrumentals give this common default mood a real pool to pick from.
notes.light_mischief: upbeat/alex-morgan-hanuman-devotional-song: rhythmic and lively enough to read as playful mischief; an approximation.
notes.telenovela_tension: epic/trailer-score-room-epic-cinematic-thriller: big, dramatic cinematic swells read as soap-opera tension.
notes.tropical_drama: upbeat/alex-morgan-nature-ambient: nature-flavoured ambience is the closest available 'tropical' cue.
notes.suspense_sting: suspense/the_mountain-epic-mood: shares the pulse_thriller track; a short dramatic cinematic cue doubles as a sting bed.
notes.lullaby_piano: sad/soulprodmusic-...-calm-piano-improvisation and upbeat/alex-morgan-gentle-baby-sleep-lullaby-dream: the second is literally titled 'lullaby dream'.
notes.gentle_strings: sad/tomomi_kato-silhouette: the gentlest, most string/ambient-leaning of the remaining sad tracks.
